Read the data

Read the data and metadata.

outDir <- "~/Projects/AML/out/DSRT"
dir.create(outDir, recursive = T)
## Warning in dir.create(outDir, recursive = T): '/home/francesco.marabita/
## Projects/AML/out/DSRT' already exists
# assayData
read.xlsx("~/Projects/AML/data/DSRT/2020-10-27/sDSS_table_1585125023.75133.xlsx",
           sheet="assayData", colNames=T, skipEmptyRows=T, rowNames=T)  %>% 
  type_convert()  -> assayData
## 
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## cols()
# pData
read.xlsx("~/Projects/AML/data/DSRT/2020-10-27/sDSS_table_1585125023.75133.xlsx",
           sheet="pData", colNames=T, skipEmptyRows=T, rowNames=F, detectDates = T) %>% 
  type_convert() -> pData1
## 
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## cols(
##   sample.ID = col_character(),
##   Patient.ID.alt = col_character(),
##   Patient.ID = col_character(),
##   DSS.file.basename = col_character()
## )
read.xlsx("~/Projects/AML/data/DSRT/2020-10-27/DSRT_metadata.xlsx",
          sheet=1, colNames=T, skipEmptyRows=T, rowNames=F, detectDates = T) %>% 
type_convert() -> pData2
## 
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## cols(
##   sample.ID = col_character(),
##   Patient.ID.alt = col_character(),
##   DSS.file.basename = col_character(),
##   Server_path = col_character(),
##   Site_of_origin = col_character(),
##   Sample_type = col_character(),
##   DSRT = col_character(),
##   Culture_medium = col_character(),
##   Drug_set_ID1 = col_character(),
##   Drug_set = col_character(),
##   Complete_set = col_character(),
##   Reader = col_character(),
##   Comments = col_character()
## )
pData <- merge(pData1, pData2, by=c("sample.ID", "Patient.ID.alt"))

# unite DSS.file.basename.x and DSS.file.basename.y
pData %>%
  unite(DSS.file.basename, DSS.file.basename.x, DSS.file.basename.y, sep = ',', remove = T, na.rm=T) %>% 
  mutate(DSS.file.basename=sapply(strsplit(DSS.file.basename,","), function(x) paste(unique(x), collapse = ","))) %>% 
  filter(sample.ID %in% pData1$sample.ID) -> pData
rownames(pData) <- pData$sample.ID

# fData
fData <- read.xlsx("~/Projects/AML/data/DSRT/2020-10-27/sDSS_table_1585125023.75133.xlsx",
           sheet="fData", colNames=T, skipEmptyRows=T, rowNames=F)
rownames(fData) <- fData$id

Remove unwanted samples

AML_039: Remove. Case not to be included in the study. AML_160: Remove. Not AML but ALL AML_195: Remove. Not AML but ALL

pData <- pData[!rownames(pData) %in% c("AML_039", "AML_160", "AML_195"),]
assayData <- assayData[,!colnames(assayData) %in% c("AML_039", "AML_160", "AML_195")]

Create SummarizedExperiment

DSRT.se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(sDSS=as.matrix(assayData)))

if(all(rownames(DSRT.se)==rownames(fData))) {
  rowData(DSRT.se) <- DataFrame(fData)
} else { stop("Order is different") }

if(all(colnames(DSRT.se)==rownames(pData))) {
  colData(DSRT.se) <- DataFrame(pData)
} else { stop("Order is different") }
plot_frequency(DSRT.se) + 
  labs(y="Number of drugs", title = "Drug overlap")

plot_missval(DSRT.se)

plot_coverage(DSRT.se) +
  labs(y="Number of drugs", title = "Drug coverage")

QC plots

boxplot(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS, las=2, ylab="sDSS")

geneplotter::multidensity(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS, legend=F)

geneplotter::multiecdf(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS, subsample=F, legend=F)

pheatmap(as.matrix(dist(t(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS))),
         clustering_distance_rows=dist(t(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS)),
         clustering_distance_cols=dist(t(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS)),
         annotation_col = data.frame(Drug_set=DSRT.se$Drug_set,
                                     Complete_set=DSRT.se$Complete_set,
                                     Site_of_origin=DSRT.se$Site_of_origin,
                                     Sample_type=DSRT.se$Sample_type,
                                     Total_live_cell_count_M=DSRT.se$Total_live_cell_count_M,
                                     Viability=DSRT.se$Viability,
                                     Date_collected =as.numeric(DSRT.se$Date_collected),
                                     row.names = DSRT.se$sample.ID),
         col=rev(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(255)),
         main="Sample distance", border_color = NA)

breaksList <- seq(-1,1, by=0.1)
pheatmap(as.matrix(cor(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS, use = "complete")),
         clustering_distance_rows=as.dist(1-cor(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS,use = "complete")),
         clustering_distance_cols=as.dist(1-cor(assays(DSRT.se)$sDSS, use = "complete")),
         annotation_col = data.frame(Drug_set=DSRT.se$Drug_set,
                                     Complete_set=DSRT.se$Complete_set,
                                     Site_of_origin=DSRT.se$Site_of_origin,
                                     Sample_type=DSRT.se$Sample_type,
                                     Total_live_cell_count_M=DSRT.se$Total_live_cell_count_M,
                                     Viability=DSRT.se$Viability,
                                     Date_collected =as.numeric(DSRT.se$Date_collected),
                                     row.names = DSRT.se$sample.ID),
         color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdBu")))(length(breaksList)),
         breaks = breaksList, main="Sample correlation", border_color = NA)
